description: The writers' room at the top of the stair: a long table, a corkboard of fixtures, and a sofa with a blanket folded on the arm. Last night's lines are on the whiteboard with the jokes crossed out. A lamp on the end desk is switched on, with tape over the switch. The stairs are down.

window.description: A ribbon window onto the lot: the court, the gatehouse at the gate and the mast on the stage's roof, with the blinds at three different heights.
window.name: the ribbon window

name: KSAB5 Writers' Room
